digest.component_or_area: op-cert signing environment and enforcement mechanism
propositions: MCP container must sign op-certs (plan-review and completion-verifier) under the existing environment 9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65 by composing a signer binding from environment principal and materialized Ed25519 key at startup.
Container-minted op-certs must verify against the pinned public key in .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml; foreign-key signed certs must be rejected.

The enforce/grandfather mechanism must enforce completion-verifier certs only for closes after a configurable boundary (opcert_enforce_since), while grandfathering pre-boundary closes to advisory status.

Move-1 (container signing provisioning) is additive and reversible; move-2 (authoritative enforcement flip) is deferred to a human-run operator runbook to prevent retroactive merge-gate failures on local-CLI closes.
The rollback posture (unsetting verify.require_environment) must return verify-opcert to advisory everywhere and preserve the existing opcert-minted cert trust path.

A runbook document (infra/runbooks/mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md) must specify exact rebar.toml keys, preconditions that all post-boundary closes route through 9f1c8e42, expand-contract ordering, and rollback procedure.
